description: Read a chapter or section of Hendrik Kleinwächter's open-source book The Sourdough Framework in full, by its number from get_sourdough_book_contents or by its title. Returns the text with its chapter, link and licence; a chapter longer than about 40,000 characters comes in pages. Without a Loafy account, reading and searching the book and the answers is limited to 3 questions a day, every lookup within 15 minutes counting as one question; with an account it has no limit. The calculators, the guides and the book's table of contents need no account.

page.description: Which page of a long chapter. Most parts have one.

part.description: A chapter or section: its number from get_sourdough_book_contents, e.g. "8" or "8.3", or its title, e.g. "Bulk fermentation".

name: read_sourdough_book
title: Read The Sourdough Framework
